book_meta.work: short stories by Guy de Maupassant and Anton Chekhov
book_meta.author: Maupassant (d. 1893) and Chekhov (d. 1904)
book_meta.status: public domain — retold from the plots, not from any translation

sentences.ar: بأيام الحصار، الأكل كان قليل بباريس.
sentences.en: In the days of the siege, food was scarce in Paris.

sentences.ar: اتنين أصحاب كانوا يصطادوا سمك قبل الحرب.
sentences.en: Two friends used to fish before the war.
They met in the street and remembered the days at the river.
They decided to go out and fish as they used to.

sentences.ar: أخذوا ورقة إذن وطلعوا برا المدينة.
sentences.en: They took a pass and went outside the city.
They sat by the water and began fishing and talking.

sentences.ar: السمك كان بيجي، والشمس كانت دافية.
sentences.en: The fish were coming, and the sun was warm.
They forgot the war for two hours.

sentences.ar: الضابط قال: أعطوني كلمة السر وبتروحوا.
sentences.en: The officer said: give me the password and you may go.
The two were silent and did not speak.

sentences.ar: بعدها، الضابط أخذ السمك وقال للطباخ: اقليه.
sentences.en: Afterwards, the officer took the fish and said to the cook: fry it.
